0.content: Jahoda is the Curatorium's only official employee, a former Seahook Gang member with a robotic arm made by Aino, which Nefer paid for up front ("I'm not even charging interest on the repayments"). Nefer calls her reckless and proud but brave and kind, the most valuable employee she has, and says immaturity is a blessing because after maturity "it's all downhill". Jahoda calls Nefer "Nef" and the best boss in the world, because she pays on time and covers food and board. They bicker about pay, botched errands and Ashru, who Jahoda says never completes a single commission.

1.content: Ashru is Nefer's black cat, who sits on the Curatorium counter "to welcome our clients". When Nefer bargained with the Ibis King in Aaru, Thoth spoke to her through Ashru's body and felt the cat's sensations. Nefer learned this only after Thoth had left. She keeps Ashru because he is adorable and because Thoth may use him again; she will not miss the chance a second time.

2.content: The Frostmoon Scions' Moonchanter and Nefer have an uneasy, respectful rivalry. Nefer mocks her saintly charisma and warns people they will be converted before they notice; she is uneasy that Lauma knows her a little too well. Lauma says they are different people with different ways, but that has never meant they cannot get along. When Lauma first asked Nefer to help infiltrate the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, Nefer refused, citing the Curatorium's neutrality.

3.content: Nefer says Flins wears etiquette "like a suit of shining armor", impeccable and impenetrable. Whether he is a Lightkeeper or a fae, from Nod-Krai or Snezhnaya, makes no difference to her: friendship rests on trust. Flins calls her intuition a knife no one wants to contend with, and hopes she won't pry into his background.

4.content: Thoth, one of King Deshret's Seven Pillars, was trapped in Aaru. After her revenge on the Iab, Nefer found his temple near her ruined home, and through Ashru he offered her power. She told him that when a deity uses wisdom to deceive, people will be deceived, so she would believe none of his words, only the power. His gift was a chessboard built to the same design as the one in the Mausoleum of King Deshret, which lets her perceive hidden secrets and view memories.

5.content: Nefer was the adopted daughter of Sinuhe, chief of the impoverished Shimti tribe, who dreamed of leading his people to somewhere better. When sandstorms collapsed their wells, he took water from a well held by the rival Iab. The Iab massacred the Shimti in revenge. Nefer survived hiding in a cellar, and for years she dreamed of a blood-darkened sword coming down on her.

6.comment: Nefer: Aaru Village, Candace and the Akademiya
6.content: Orphaned, Nefer reached Aaru Village, where Candace was one of the few children willing to talk to her; together they drove off beasts and bandits and cared for people in hardship. Uncle Anpu brought a Mahamata to see her talent and the Akademiya admitted her. She was sent to Vahumana without the entrance test because she was from the desert; the researcher Cyrus objected and was told to keep quiet "unless you want trouble from Azar's ilk".

7.comment: Nefer: The Curatorium and the Northern Intelligence Network
7.content: The Curatorium of Secrets, at the heart of Nasha Town, takes any commission, from lost cats to debts to heartbreak, and keeps strict neutrality among Nod-Krai's factions. It is also the main point of sale for the Northern Intelligence Network, a loose, volunteer-run forum for trading intel, with spies in every nation except Liyue. Only clients with a "key" reach that inner sanctum. Nefer is its current representative.

8.content: Dori, Lord Sangemah Bay, is Nefer's regular business partner and fellow countrywoman; she brings Mora and news from Sumeru. Nefer saved Dori's life when she first arrived in Nod-Krai and her jinni fainted from the kuuvahki. Nefer enjoys toying with her: she accepts Dori's expensive gift wine, keeps her guessing about a deal, and praises her for staying at "the card table" of Sumeru.

9.content: Yelan is one of the Network's most valued clients. She pays up front in cash, often two or three times the asking price, so Nefer never gets a favour to cash in. She also blocks every Network attempt to plant agents in Liyue. Over cocktails at the Flagship, Yelan warns that Nefer's claws will never get into Liyue. Nefer plays innocent about several suspicious newcomers there.
